secrets.name: GEMINI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. Google Gemini API key for real identity-preserving image generation. Without it the app uses the bundled mock image provider (solid PNGs). Get it from Google AI Studio (aistudio.google.com).

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: Optional. OpenAI API key for the OpenAI image provider fallback. Without it the mock provider is used. Get it from platform.openai.com.
